source.author: ov
source.text: Ecce rapit mediis flagrantem Rhoetus ab aris pruniceum torrem dextraque a parte Charaxi tempora perstringit fulvo protecta capillo.
source.text_original: Ecce rapit mediis flagrantem Rhoetus ab aris / pruniceum torrem dextraque a parte Charaxi / tempora perstringit fulvo protecta capillo.
source.text_english: Behold, Rhoetus snatches from the middle of the blazing altars a torch of cornel wood and with his right hand grazes Charaxus’ temples, protected by tawny hair.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: optimus hasta hic Peleus, hic ense furens agnoscitur Aeson; fert gravis invito victorem Nestora tergo Monychus, ardenti peragit Clanis Actora quercu; nigro Nessus equo fugit, acclinisque tapetis in mediis vacuo condit caput Hippasus auro.
reuse.text_original: optimus hasta / hic Peleus, hic ense furens agnoscitur Aeson; / fert gravis invito victorem Nestora tergo / Monychus, ardenti peragit Clanis Actora quercu; / nigro Nessus equo fugit, acclinisque tapetis / in mediis vacuo condit caput Hippasus auro.
reuse.text_english: Here Peleus is recognized as the best with the spear, here Aeson is raging with the sword; heavy Monychus carries Nestor, the victor, on his unwilling back, Clanis pursues Actora with a blazing oak; Nessus flees on a black horse, and Hippasus, leaning against the tapestries in the midst, buries his head in empty gold.
